title: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr. Angan Guha as President and Chief Executive Officer for Americas 2 Strategic Market Unit of the company w.e.f. December 08, 2026.

changes.label: Appointed
changes.role: President and Chief Executive Officer for Americas 2 Strategic Market Unit

profile.quote: Angan Guha is a seasoned technology and business leader with over 34 years of experience driving growth, digital transformation, and client success across multiple geographies. He is known for his results-oriented leadership with a focus on building growth-oriented organizations.
profile.summary: Angan Guha is a seasoned technology and business leader with over 34 years of experience in driving growth, digital transformation, and client success.

headline: Appointed: Angan Guha, President and Chief Executive Officer for Americas 2 Strategic Market Unit, from 8 Dec 2026
